newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacificare cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacificare cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist downgraded shares of PacifiCare Health Systems Inc to hold from strong buy due to uncertainty surrounding the merging of operations with FHP International.
-- In addition Hambrecht cut fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $4.75/shr from $4.95 and fiscal 1998 to $5.70/shr from $5.85, "to account for the lower level of realized synergies."

-- Hambrecht said PacifiCare sees FHP markets in Utah, Nevada and Texas underperforming their plan. PacifiCare's commercial medical loss ratio will not be as great an area of synergy as thought, it said. Lastly, it said FHP's enrollment growth will be "in the low single digits" for the rest of 1997.
